title: Daśaślokī
subtitle: Ten verses on the Self as the sole reality

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 15, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
न भूमिर्न तोयं न तेजो न वायुः
न खं नेन्द्रियं वा न तेषां समूहः ।
अनेकान्तिकत्वात् सुषुप्त्येकसिद्धः
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am not earth, water, fire, air, space, the senses, or their aggregate. Because these are inconstant, the one Self alone is established in deep sleep; that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
न वर्णा न वर्णाश्रमाचारधर्मा
न मे धारणाध्यानयोगादयोऽपि ।
अनात्माश्रयाहंममाध्यासहानात्
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am not the social classes or the duties of class and life-stage; practices such as concentration, meditation, and yoga are not mine either. With the relinquishing of the superimposition of “I” and “mine” that rests on the non-self, that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

gloss.en: duties of class, life-stage, and conduct

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
न माता पिता वा न देवा न लोका
न वेदा न यज्ञा न तीर्थं ब्रुवन्ति ।
सुषुप्तौ निरस्तातिशून्यात्मकत्वात्
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: The sages say: there is no mother or father, no gods or worlds, no Vedas, sacrifices, or sacred places. In deep sleep the notion of absolute voidness is itself negated; that sole auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

gloss.en: because the nature of utter voidness is negated

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
न साङ्ख्यं न शैवं न तत्पाञ्चरात्रं
न जैनं न मीमांसकादेर्मतं वा ।
विशिष्टानुभूत्या विशुद्धात्मकत्वात्
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am not Sāṃkhya, Śaiva doctrine, that Pāñcarātra, Jain doctrine, or the view of Mīmāṃsakas and others. Through direct realization and the purity of the Self, that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

gloss.en: because of the nature of the Self

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
न चोर्ध्वं न चाधो न चान्तर्न बाह्यं
न मध्यं न तिर्यङ् न पूर्वापरा दिक् ।
वियद्व्यापकत्वादखण्डैकरूपः
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am neither above nor below, neither within nor without; neither in the middle nor across, nor an eastern or western direction. Because I pervade space, I am indivisible and of one nature; that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
न शुक्लं न कृष्णं न रक्तं न पीतं
न कुब्जं न पीनं न ह्रस्वं न दीर्घम् ।
अरूपं तथा ज्योतिराकारकत्वात्
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am neither white nor black, red nor yellow; neither hunched nor broad, short nor tall. I am formless and of the very nature of light; that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

gloss.en: because of being of that very nature

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
न शास्ता न शास्त्रं न शिष्यो न शिक्षा
न च त्वं न चाहं न चायं प्रपञ्चः ।
स्वरूपावबोधो विकल्पासहिष्णुः
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: There is no teacher, scripture, pupil, or instruction; no “you,” no “I,” and no world of appearances. Self-knowledge cannot admit distinctions; that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

units.label: Verse 8
units.deva:
न जाग्रन्न मे स्वप्नको वा सुषुप्तिर्न
विश्वो न वा तैजसः प्राज्ञको वा ।
अविद्यात्मकत्वात्त्रयाणां तुरीयः
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am neither waking, nor dream, nor deep sleep; nor am I Viśva, Taijasa, or Prājña. Since the three states are founded in ignorance, I am the Fourth; that auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

gloss.en: because of having the nature of

units.label: Verse 9
units.deva:
अपि व्यापकत्वाद्धि तत्त्वप्रयोगात्
स्वतःसिद्धभावादनन्याश्रयत्वात् ।
जगत्तुच्छमेतत्समस्तं तदन्यत्
तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: Because the Self is all-pervading, directly established as reality, self-evident, and dependent on nothing else, this entire world, as something other than the Self, is insignificant. That auspicious One remains, and I alone am That.

gloss.en: because of its application or direct presence

units.label: Verse 10
units.deva:
न चैकं तदन्यद्द्वितीयं कुतः स्यात्
न केवलत्वं न चाकेवलत्वम् ।
न शून्यं न चाशून्यमद्वैतकत्वात्
कथं सर्ववेदान्तसिद्धं ब्रवीमि ॥
units.translation: There is not even one thing distinct from That; whence could a second arise? There is neither absolute singleness nor non-singleness, neither void nor non-void, because reality is non-dual. How can I express what all Vedānta establishes?

gloss.en: that which is established by all Vedānta

units.label: Colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ दशश्लोकी समाप्ता ॥
units.translation: Thus ends the Daśaślokī, composed by the revered Śaṅkara, the disciple of the revered Govinda Bhagavatpāda, who was an eminent teacher and wandering paramahaṃsa.

gloss.en: of the teacher of wandering renunciants
